purpose: Opt-in Vulkan GPU/text development candidate. The pinned binary passes help/device discovery; model/context fit and analytic quality remain unqualified until separately probed. No acceleration or usable-memory claim follows from device enumeration.

runtime.qualification: Pinned extracted Vulkan binary ran --help and --list-devices, both exit 0. Vulkan0: Qualcomm Adreno X1-85 was enumerated with a driver-reported 12086 MiB shared budget. Extracted files were rehashed unchanged after the probes. No model was loaded and no inference ran; this is not dedicated VRAM or a model-fit/speed measurement.

model.license_evidence: Qwen original model card and pinned Unsloth quantization metadata identify Apache-2.0. Quantization is published by Unsloth, not Qwen.

installation.supported_installer_platform: Windows ARM64 only. Unsupported operating systems or architectures are rejected before downloads or cache writes. The read-only plan remains available on any platform.
installation.scope: Dedicated llama.cpp/b11457-vulkan-arm64 sibling cache; CPU llama.cpp/b11457 is preserved. Existing identical 9B model/projector cache entries are verified and reused. No administrator privileges, global PATH edits or credentials.
installation.verification: Exact size and SHA256 checked before archive extraction or model use.
installation.network: Pinned GitHub llama.cpp and Unsloth Hugging Face assets; services may redirect to asset CDNs. Local inference only.
installation.resources: Model plus projector files total 5591809824 bytes; they are unchanged from candidate-9b and reused when cached. The 25918589-byte Vulkan archive is separate. These are file sizes, not GPU/shared-memory requirements. Driver/backend, device discovery, text-only load and context fit need a measured controlled probe before an investigation; use --no-mmproj for that text-only probe.
installation.cost: No paid service or subscription required; local compute, disk, electricity, and download bandwidth remain resource requirements.
